thesis: The episode introduces Andy Golden, the president of Princeton University's investment management company, who has led the endowment from $3 billion to $22.5 billion over 22 years. The conversation explores his transition from a career as a photographer to professional investing, his philosophical approach to organizational management, and his early interest in socially responsible investing.
